elements.label: Figure 1.1
elements.title: Petroglyphs are one of the earliest types of data generated by humanity, providing vital information about the daily life of the people who created them.
elements.details: Photo of petroglyphs (rock carvings) showing various shapes including animals, human figures, and a wheel-like symbol.
elements.summary: This decorative image illustrates ancient petroglyphs as an example of early data created by humans, emphasizing the historical roots of data collection.
